nom: LUSH Happy Skin Enzymic Facial Exfoliator

avis.texte: I did a good amount of research before purchasing this product. I was looking for a good every day use exfoliating face wash to use with my other cleansing face wash. I was originally going to purchase this from LUSH's website but I couldn't bring myself to pay for $8 shipping on just one item. I was happy to find this product on Ulta's website and utilize the free shipping on $35+. I don't really have sensitive skin but I do have some texture on my chin area and I usually get the occasional blemish in that area. Also I do infact get oily skin by the end of the day. I have been using this product every night for over a week now after using my normal cleansing face wash. I enjoy how the exfoliation of the product feels like I am really cleaning my face, it's the perfect amount of exfoliation that I feel like I can use it every day. I have noticed my skin feels smoother on my chin area and that my oil feels controlled throughout the night and I don't wake up with a ton of oil on my face. I would recommend this product!
Ive tried cheaper options from the drug store but theyre just not the same. I love this one and keep going back to it.
The lid had opened a bit and product had leaked all over the contents in my box and the inside of my box. This product is too expensive to waste.

Ive had pretty good skin the majority of my life, with the occasional pimple popping up during my time of the month. Im 30 now and i just had my 4th child 6 months ago. Since he was born, my acne was the worst its ever been. I noticed they were always by my mouth and chin, which means people tend to see them even if theres not many, they are noticable. Ive used this stuff for 4 days in a row now and EVERY single spot has disappeared from my face, whats even more exciting— it seems to be preventing any new ones from forming! For the first time in 6 months my skin is completely clear again. Thank you lush!

I noticed a real difference in one time of use. My skin was radiant and felt so good. I can't to used it again tonight. Amazing exfoliator. The smell is so refreshing also. It is not harsh and I tend to have dry skin. It did not make my skin feel cracked and dry. I was left feeling really refreshed. TIP put in refrigerator (not necessary) for an awesome cooling experience.

I tried this in the smaller version, fell in love. Unfortunately i was a st.ives scrub girly but this made me switch! Great product for my oily skin but i think any sort of skin would benefit from this!

Great face wash! Cleanses thoroughly with an everyday gentle exfoliation leaving skin super soft and clean. For use on normal, combination or dry skin with minimal chance of irritation since it uses natural ingredients. Very dry skin doesn't need exfoliation so you may want to try ultraplant. Has a soft, fresh scent that washes away
This product has smoothed my complexion over time. Has a pleasant almost pumpkin-like smell but mild enough that your face doesnt continue to smell like it. Very gentle.
Used the exfoliate on my hand at the lush store and had no reaction. However, when I went home and used it on my face, it stung and left my face extremely oily.
